sentences.en: The police dogs found traces of cocaine in his baggage.
sentences.zh: 警方的警犬在他的行李中发现了可卡因的痕迹。

sentences.en: The police dog found trace amounts of cocaine in his luggage.
sentences.zh: 警方的警犬在他的行李中发现了少量的可卡因。

sentences.en: I thought it might be cocaine, but it was only flour.
sentences.zh: 我以为那可能是可卡因，但其实只是面粉。
